fact_english: The colasisi is a hanging parrot, part of a group of small parrots known for sleeping while hanging upside down from branches.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang colasisi, maliit na loro natin, kasama sa grupo ng mga lorong natutulog nang nakabitin, patiwarik!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Baligtad matulog, tuwid gumising. Sana all.

after_text: Minana ko pala ang tinakbuhan ni Lolo.
why_here: After 'Minana ko pala ang tinakbuhan ni Lolo.': what Lolo buried is still unopened, and Usman digs it up right after the break.
